overview: Katta Academy is the premier arcane institution of the Loyalists, responsible for magical research, civic‑arcane stability, and the training of future magi.
history: Founded after the Loyalist schism to preserve arcane knowledge.
Designed with crystalline conduits that stabilize magic across Katta Castellum.
The Academy’s researchers developed early resonance stabilizers.
The Lecture Hall hosts debates between arcane theorists and Senate scholars.
hooks: A stabilizer malfunction threatens the Academy’s lower halls.
A student goes missing after experimenting with resonance magic.
A Senate envoy arrives to evaluate arcane safety protocols.
A forbidden tome surfaces in the Academy Archives.
